page.overview:
Who is Gerrith Barrington?

Grand Duke Gerrith Barrington, also known as Gelkanis Barinten, is a minor character from Final Fantasy Tactics. He is the liege lord of Riovanes Castle, and a possible successor in line for the Crown, as House Barrington descends directly from the old Fovohaviam royal family.

Barrington is known to many as the "King of the Forge" due to his extensive investment in firearms and combatants, including mages and assassins, best known for the Khamja. His aim is the throne of Ivalice.

He uses the unique job of grand duke (or arc duke in the PS1 version).

Barrington did not serve in battle during the war due to his lack of combat prowess, but his wealth and influence allowed him to assemble large groups of sellswords from foreign lands to fight in his name. Among these warriors were a group of war orphans trained as assassins, the Khamja.
